name: Rebel Studios Invoice Documents for WooCommerce
author: Rebel Studios Software

sections.description:
Give every WooCommerce order a clean PDF invoice, packing slip and delivery note — generated on your own server, attached to the right order email automatically, and printable in one click from the order screen.

Built for the current WooCommerce: classic and block checkout, and HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage).

What it does

  • PDF invoice for any order — branded with your logo, business details and accent color.
  • Packing slip and delivery note — quantities for the warehouse, no prices.
  • Automatic email attachment — attach the invoice PDF to the Processing or Completed order email.
  • One-click print or download from the order screen (classic and HPOS).
  • Sequential or order-number invoice numbering, with an optional prefix — the assigned number is stored on the order, so a reprint never changes it.
  • A4 or Letter, full Unicode (accents and every currency symbol render correctly).
  • Graceful fallback. If your host is missing the PDF engine, documents open as clean printable pages instead, and the order email still sends.

Who it is for

Stores that put something in a box, and stores that have to bill for it.

The packing slip and the delivery note carry quantities and no prices. If you are dropshipping
that is the entire point: your supplier gets the quantities to pick, and nothing that travels with
the goods tells your customer what you paid for them. If you sell wholesale, the invoice is the
document the buyer’s accounts department actually asks for, and it is already attached to the
order email before they do.

And when the person packing the box is not the person at the keyboard, the order printout from the
order screen is the sheet they carry to the shelf.

Invoice numbering

Choose sequential invoice numbering or the WooCommerce order number, with an optional prefix such as INV-. In sequential mode the counter advances once per order and the assigned sequential invoice number is written to the order, so a reprint six months later shows the same number and previews never burn one.

Plainly, so nobody buys on a wrong assumption: numbers are not zero-padded (INV-7, not INV-0007), the counter does not reset each year, and a number is assigned the first time a document is generated for an order — so the sequence follows generation order, not order date.

Add-ons

Bulk printing is available as a separate plugin, Rebel Studios Invoice Documents Pro: tick any number of orders in the orders list and print them as one PDF with a page per order, instead of opening fifty. $49 a year for one site, or $147 once for a lifetime licence, with a 7-day money-back guarantee.

What the add-on does not do, so the $49 is not a surprise: it adds bulk printing for invoices and packing slips only — delivery notes are still printed one order at a time. It adds no new document types, no new templates and no new email behaviour, and it needs this free plugin installed. Everything described above works on its own, forever, without it.

Privacy

Everything is generated on your own server with dompdf. No order data is sent anywhere, and PDF rendering has remote access disabled — your logo is embedded directly, so the plugin makes no external requests.

The invoice PDF attached to an order email is written to a private temporary folder and deleted as soon as that email has been sent, or has failed to send.

Other plugins by Rebel Studios

Focused WooCommerce plugins that each do one job well:

  • Restaurant Menu & Reservations — QR code menu and table reservations.
  • Brazilian Checkout Fields for WooCommerce — CPF/CNPJ validation and CEP autofill for Brazilian stores.
  • Rebel Studios Event Tickets & QR Check-in — events, RSVP and QR tickets you scan at the door.
  • Rebel Studios Membership & Content Restriction — restrict content to members, with front-end registration.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate it, or install it from Plugins → Add New.
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Invoices and enter your business name, address and logo.
  3. Choose which order email carries the invoice PDF.
  4. Open any order — the Invoices box on the right prints an invoice, packing slip or delivery note.

Requires WooCommerce. For true PDF files your host needs the standard PHP dom and mbstring extensions (enabled on essentially all WordPress hosts).
sections.faq:
Does it work with the new block checkout and HPOS?

Yes. It declares compatibility with both and reads order data the same way in each.

Where are invoice numbers stored?

On the order itself. Once an invoice number is assigned it is saved, so reprinting an invoice always shows the same number.

My host shows a “PDF engine unavailable” notice.

Your PHP is missing the dom or mbstring extension. Ask your host to enable them (standard on almost all hosts). Until then, documents open as printable web pages.

Can I customize the template?

Logo, business details, accent color, footer note, font and paper size are all configurable from the settings screen.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Security: the invoice PDF attached to an order email is now deleted as soon as the email is sent, or fails to send. Earlier versions left a copy in the server’s temp folder named invoice-<number>.pdf. On sites whose temp folder is inside wp-content, anyone who guessed the number could download it.
  • While the email is being sent, the PDF now sits in a folder with a random name that only your site can open.
  • This update does not delete the copies 1.0.0 and 1.0.1 left behind, because other plugins can use the same file names. If the invoice was attached to your emails, delete the invoice-*.pdf files in your temp folder: WP_TEMP_DIR if your site defines it, otherwise usually /tmp, or wp-content where /tmp is not writable.

1.0.1

  • The in-plugin upgrade button now links to the Pro page directly.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: PDF invoices, packing slips and delivery notes; email attachment; per-order printing; classic + block + HPOS.
